title: Fix social media icon visibility in footer

requirements.text: Ensure the WhatsApp icon SVG path element in the footer is properly visible with correct fill color and styling, located at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/footer[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[4]/div[1]/a[3]/svg[1]/path[1]
acceptanceCriteria: The WhatsApp icon SVG path in the footer social media section renders visibly on the deployed site
The icon has proper fill color matching the design system
The icon is clickable and maintains hover states
All other social media icons (Facebook, X, YouTube) remain properly visible alongside the fixed WhatsApp icon

constraints: Maintain existing social media link structure and accessibility attributes
Do not change the backend or other frontend components
nonGoals: Modifying other footer sections like quick links or contact information
Changing the overall footer layout or structure
